description: This datapack ensures that the armor you are wearing is taken into account, even for damage types (such as drowning) that would normally ignore armor.
body: This datapack ensures that the armor you are wearing is taken into account, even for damage types (such as drowning) that would normally ignore armor.For example (I tested this myself), underwater drowning damage is reduced (as shown by the icon) when wearing netherite armor (or other types of armor).
